en: Copying something large no longer slows clicks and typing: images and long text cross to the other Mac only when you paste them there.
Copies of up to 64 MB per type are shared.
With several Macs connected, a copy reaches all of them once and no longer bounces between them.
zh-Hans: 复制大内容不再拖慢点击和输入：图片和长文本只有在另一台 Mac 上粘贴时才会传过去。
每种类型最大 64 MB 的复制内容都可以共享。
连接多台 Mac 时，复制的内容只会送达每台一次，不再来回反弹。
